messages.subject: output no AIC and BIC
parts:
Hi, everyone

I wonder to know why the summary output did not show AIC and BIC when I used  estimator="DWLS"?

Did I miss some steps? I use this grammar "summary(fit,fit.measures=T)" but still no AIC and BIC.

Thanks for help.

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: output no AIC and BIC
parts:
Information criteria (as well as ECVI and log-likelihood itself: "logl") are likelihood-based, so they are not available for any of the least-squares estimators (ULS, GLS, WLS)

Terry
